content:
The clinic's work includes baby and infant circumcision, circumcision for children and teenagers, adult circumcision, medical foreskin problems, re-circumcision and practitioner training.

Procedures are carried out in a dedicated clinical environment with attention to infection control, consent, anaesthesia, aftercare and follow-up.

  • More than four decades of surgical practice
  • GMC-registered plastic surgeon
  • Member of the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh
  • Member of the British College of Aesthetic Medicine
  • Circumcision, re-circumcision and revision for all ages

Plastic surgeon

Dr Samir Al-Ali

GMC-Registered Medical Practitioner | Plastic Surgeon | Member of the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh | Member of the British College of Aesthetic Medicine

Dr Samir Al-Ali is a GMC-registered plastic surgeon. He qualified in medicine in Iraq in 1984 and has worked in the NHS and in private healthcare in the United Kingdom and overseas for more than four decades.

He performs circumcision for babies, children, teenagers and adults, including non-therapeutic, therapeutic, re-circumcision and revision procedures, and has trained doctors from the UK and overseas.

Dr Samir Al-Ali is an experienced, GMC-registered medical practitioner with an extensive surgical career spanning more than four decades. He qualified in medicine in Iraq in 1984 and has since worked in both the United Kingdom and overseas, gaining considerable experience in the NHS and private healthcare.

Throughout his career, Dr Al-Ali has performed a wide range of surgical procedures, including complex and life-saving operations. His experience encompasses plastic, reconstructive and cosmetic surgery, providing him with extensive knowledge of surgical techniques, anatomy and patient care.

Full biography

Dr Al-Ali has considerable experience in male circumcision, performing procedures for babies, children, teenagers and adults. He carries out both non-therapeutic circumcisions, requested for religious, cultural or personal reasons, and therapeutic circumcisions for medical conditions such as phimosis and balanitis xerotica obliterans (BXO). He also performs re-circumcisions and revision procedures for patients who require further treatment following a previous circumcision.

Alongside his clinical work, Dr Al-Ali has trained numerous doctors from the UK and overseas in circumcision techniques, sharing his surgical knowledge and emphasising safe practice, appropriate patient assessment and aftercare. He has also played an important role in mentoring his son, Dr Haidar Al-Ali, who began working alongside him in 2007.

Dr Al-Ali is registered with the General Medical Council (GMC) and is a member of the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh and the British College of Aesthetic Medicine. His extensive experience across different surgical disciplines provides a strong foundation for his circumcision practice, particularly when assessing and treating patients with more complex medical or surgical needs.

His approach combines decades of surgical experience, technical expertise and a commitment to high standards of patient care, providing reassurance to patients and families seeking both routine and medically indicated circumcision at Beverley Clinic.

Circumcision practitioner

Dr Haidar Al-Ali

Circumcision Practitioner | BDS, King's College London | Member of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Glasgow

Dr Haidar Al-Ali has been involved in circumcision care since 2007, training alongside his father, Dr Samir Al-Ali. He qualified as a dentist from King's College London in 2013 and then began performing circumcisions independently.

He has carried out thousands of procedures for babies, children, teenagers and adults, performs most of the clinic's non-therapeutic circumcisions, and trains doctors from the UK and overseas.

Full biography

Dr Haidar Al-Ali is an experienced circumcision practitioner who has been involved in circumcision care since 2007. He began his training and practical experience working alongside his father, Dr Samir Al-Ali, assisting with circumcision procedures and developing his knowledge of circumcision techniques and patient care.

After qualifying as a dentist from King's College London in 2013, Dr Al-Ali began performing circumcisions independently. Since then, he has carried out thousands of circumcision procedures for babies, children, teenagers and adults, gaining extensive practical experience across different age groups and circumcision techniques.

In addition to his clinical work, Dr Al-Ali has trained numerous doctors from the UK and overseas in circumcision techniques, with a particular emphasis on safe practice, appropriate patient assessment and aftercare.

He performs the majority of the clinic's non-therapeutic circumcisions, including procedures requested for religious, cultural and personal reasons. Many families come to him through word-of-mouth recommendations, with parents frequently returning with younger children or recommending his care to relatives and friends.

Dr Al-Ali is a qualified dentist and a member of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Glasgow. His circumcision practice is based on his dedicated training and extensive practical experience in circumcision, developed separately from his dental qualification.

His approach combines extensive practical experience with a genuine commitment to patient care, earning the trust of families who continue to recommend him across generations.

  • Circumcision care since 2007
  • BDS, King's College London
  • Member of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Glasgow
  • Thousands of procedures across all age groups
  • Trains doctors in safe practice, assessment and aftercare
